body.p: This paper is being presented in response to the non-final official action dated

September 4, 2024, wherein: (a) claims 1-17 are pending; (b) claim 12 was allowed; (c) claim 13 was objected to as being in improper form; and (d) claims 1-11 were rejected under 35 USC § 112(b) as being indefinite.
Reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejections are respectfully requested in view of the foregoing amendments and following remarks.
By way of this paper, claims 1 - 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13 are amended, new claims 14 -17 are added and no claims have been cancelled or withdrawn
Support for the claim amendments and the new claims can be found throughout the application as originally filed.
No new matter is added by the amendments.

The Applicant gratefully acknowledges the Examiner's recognition in the Office Action that claim12 is allowed. Additionally, claims 1-11 are indicated to be allowable if rewritten to overcome the rejections under 35 USC § 112(b). The rejections under 35 USC §112 are addressed herein.
The Applicant respectfully submits that all claims are in condition for allowance.
Claim 13 was objected to.
Claim 13 is amended to remove the reference claim 1.
Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the claim objection.
Claims 1-11 were rejected under 35 USC § 112(b) as being indefinite.
Claims 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, and 11 are amended to address the antecedent basis issues mentioned in the Office action.
Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the rejections under 35 USC § 112(b).

In view of the foregoing, the Applicant believes the pending application to be in condition for allowance. Should the Examiner wish to discuss the foregoing, or any matter of form or procedure in an effort to advance this application to allowance, the Examiner is urged to contact the undersigned attorney at the indicated telephone number set forth below.

Applicant believes no fee is due with this response. However, if a fee is due, please charge our Deposit Account No. 13-2855, under Order No. 33590/59023 from which the undersigned is authorized to draw.
Dated: February 10, 2025 Respectfully submitted,
